objective: Turn AG's per-residual structure-aware raw-DP success into a stronger analytic existence certificate using an exact average raw-mass identity, or emit the first reachable residual that defeats the certificate or the actual raw-pivot existence condition.

definitions: For pivot x, M_x is removed parent mass: number of clauses containing +/-x plus the sum of their clause lengths.
P_x is the exact non-tautological raw resolvent mass before pair dedup/subsumption: for every positive/negative parent pair whose merged resolvent is not tautological, add 1+|resolvent|.
For tautology-free canonical CNF, sum_x M_x = L + sum_clause |clause|^2.
Therefore sum_x RAW_S(x) = V*S - L - sum_clause |clause|^2 + sum_x P_x.
frozen_identity.proof_contract: Every equality is checked independently from explicit clauses and parent pairs. Canonical exact-DP NF may only reduce the raw pair-multiset mass, so S_exact_after(x) <= RAW_S(x).

frozen_existence_certificate.consequence: By min<=average, some pivot x has RAW_S(x)<=T; hence 2*RAW_S(x)<=B and RAW_S(x)^2<=B*(V-1), and the exact canonical DP result preserves the frozen post-transition invariant.

roots: degree-3 GPHP h=6,8,10,12,16,20 in CYCLIC_MIX and SEEDED_BALANCED
domain.route: Reproduce the same truth-blind analytic selector used by AB/AD/AF to generate root-reachable residual states. At each residual audit all raw pivots, but preserve the legacy selector for route continuation so AH does not change reachability after seeing results.

priority: A reachable no-admissible-pivot witness overrides a merely failed average certificate. A failed average certificate with an admissible pivot refutes only this proof route, not AG's selector existence on that state.
